name: Vanguard
tagline: An autonomous whitehat system for vulnerability discovery.
pitch: Vanguard explores a codebase the way an attacker would, then proves every finding the way an auditor must. Intelligence for exploration, determinism for proof, and a memory that compounds: every bug hour makes the next hunt faster.

stages.label: codebase + scope
stages.blurb: The target: source code, pinned and scoped.

stages.label: explore
stages.blurb: Agents map the attack surface and hunt for weak points.

stages.label: hypothesize
stages.blurb: Candidate vulnerabilities, reasoned about and ranked by reachability and impact.

stages.label: prove
stages.blurb: Every candidate must reproduce as a runnable proof-of-concept. No proof, no report.

stages.label: verified findings
stages.blurb: Vulnerabilities delivered with deterministic proof. Signal, not speculation.

stages.label: memory
stages.blurb: Findings, dead ends, and fixes feed an updating memory. The next hunt starts smarter.

slides.title: The problem
slides.body: Billions sit in contracts audited once, by hand, under time pressure, while the code keeps shipping. Attackers need one bug. Defenders need all of them.

slides.title: Meet Vanguard
slides.body: An autonomous whitehat system for vulnerability discovery. Vanguard explores a codebase the way an attacker would, and proves every finding the way an auditor must.

slides.title: Intelligence for exploration
slides.body: Agents map the attack surface, reason about incentives, and rank hypotheses by reachability and impact. Exploration is creative, and it never sleeps.

slides.title: Determinism for proof
slides.body: Every candidate vulnerability must reproduce as a runnable proof-of-concept. No proof, no report. Findings you can verify, not speculation you must trust.

slides.title: Memory that compounds
slides.body: Findings, dead ends, and fixes feed an updating memory: every bug hour makes the next hunt faster. An advantage that compounds, hunt after hunt.
